verdict_rationale: The terminal close STOCKS_NG4_BLOCKED_SOURCE_OR_SCHEMA at budget 0/6 is correct and fully evidenced. Every hash recomputed matches MANIFEST.json (5/5). The branch chain contains only the two declared commits over base 19360f18 with zero census code, zero adapter edits, zero bulk data. Zero unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL findings. The auditor independently hunted for a permissive FINRA data license the lane might have missed (developer.finra.org API Terms of Service) and confirmed it is restrictive and registration-gated, not permissive — the close is unaffected.
